_note: 在线公告：直接改本文件并 push 到 main 分支即可，客户端下次启动会拉取，不需要发新版本。`updated` 变化时，已经读过公告的用户也会重新看到红点（内容更新提示）；新增条目按 id 判为未读。

title.zh_CN: 1.4.4：MAA 更新后「Link Start!」找不到？已修好
title.en_US: 1.4.4: fixed the missing "Link Start!" button after a MAA update

body.zh_CN:
**现象**：执行任务时 MAA 阶段一直提示「找图超时，未能找到: maa_start.png」，等了三次共 3 分钟也没点到 Link Start，可按钮明明就在屏幕左下角。

**原因**：MAA v6.21 改了主界面按钮的渲染和尺寸，内置模板（9 月截的 144×68）对当前界面最高只有 0.74 的匹配度，阈值是 0.80 —— 找图逻辑没坏，是模板过期了。

**这一版**：按 MAA 6.21 重新截了内置 `maa_start.png`（132×66），对失败现场匹配度 1.00，把截图缩放到 0.90~1.50 倍再搜也都能命中。

同时把失败原因说清楚：

- 找图超时后，日志与托盘提醒会告诉你可能是 MAA / MaaEnd 改版、换了主题或自定义背景，并指向「设置 → 模板」重新截取；
- 窗口被拖到屏幕外时立即报错（不再白等 60 秒、不再重试 3 次），提示先把窗口移回屏幕内；
- 模板文件缺失时直接报错并列出查找过的目录，不再「什么都没点却继续跑」。
body.en_US:
**Symptom**: the MAA stage kept reporting "image search timed out, could not find: maa_start.png" for three 60-second attempts, never clicking Link Start - even though the button was sitting in the bottom-left corner.

**Cause**: MAA v6.21 changed how the main-window button is drawn and sized. The bundled template (144x68, captured in September) only reached a 0.74 match score against the new UI, while the threshold is 0.80. The matching code was fine - the template was stale.

**This release**: the bundled `maa_start.png` was recaptured against MAA 6.21 (132x66). It scores 1.00 on the failure screenshot and still matches at 0.90x - 1.50x scaling.

Failures are also explained now:

- on a match timeout, the log and the tray notification say it is probably a MAA / MaaEnd redesign, a theme or a custom background, and point to Settings > Templates;
- a window dragged off-screen fails immediately (no more 60-second wait or 3 retries), telling you to move it back;
- a missing template file raises an error listing the directories that were searched instead of silently continuing.

title.zh_CN: 1.4.3：修「设置 → 应用」里的版本号不跟着升级
title.en_US: 1.4.3: the Settings > Apps version now follows upgrades

body.zh_CN:
**现象**：自动升级到新版本后，「设置 → 应用」里 MaaAuto 的版本号还停在安装时的旧值（例如程序已经是 1.4.2，列表里仍写着 1.4.1）。

**原因**：自动升级只替换程序文件、不跑 Inno 安装器；那条记录是安装时写的，升级过程没有任何人刷新它。

**修复**：主程序每次启动检查一次——只有登记的安装目录正好指向自己时，才把版本号、图标、主/次版本字段更新到当前版本；失败只记调试日志，不影响启动。装上 1.4.3 后第一次启动就会自动改正。

另外加固了发布校验工具：在 Microsoft Store 版 Python（MSIX）下，`%APPDATA%` 会被重定向，以前的「开始菜单修复/还原」其实是假动作，现在改由 PowerShell 写真实路径。
body.en_US:
**Symptom**: after an automatic update, the MaaAuto version shown under Settings > Apps stayed at the value from when you originally installed (e.g. the app was 1.4.2 but the list still said 1.4.1).

**Cause**: auto-update replaces program files without running the Inno installer, and that uninstall entry is only written during installation.

**Fix**: at every startup the app checks the entry and - only when its install location points at this installation - refreshes the version, icon and major/minor fields. Failures are logged at debug level only. The first launch of 1.4.3 fixes it automatically.

Release tooling was also hardened for Microsoft Store Python (MSIX), where `%APPDATA%` writes are redirected and earlier Start Menu repairs were no-ops.

title.zh_CN: 1.4.2：修好「升级后图标、开始菜单、应用列表都没了」
title.en_US: 1.4.2: fixed the missing desktop / Start Menu icons and app-list entry

body.zh_CN:
**症状**：升级之后桌面图标、开始菜单、「设置 → 应用」里的 MaaAuto 全都消失了，Windows 还提示「系统找不到应用」。

**程序和数据一直是好的**——直接运行安装目录里的 `MaaAuto.exe` 就能正常用。坏掉的只是**登记信息**：发布前在本机跑的安装/卸载校验脚本，和你的正式安装用了同一个 Inno AppId（Inno 的「设置→应用」记录、开始菜单组、桌面快捷方式都是按 AppId 全局共享的），于是那次卸载把共享的登记一起删了。

**这一版**：校验脚本改装到独立目录 `MaaAuto_verify`，跑前备份、跑完还原，并且拒绝在正式安装目录上运行；`smoke_install.py` 也加了同样的拦截。

**已经被误删的机器不用重装**：跑一下 `tools/repair_integration.py` 就能重建图标和「设置 → 应用」条目。
body.en_US:
**Symptom**: after updating, the desktop icon, the Start Menu entry and the MaaAuto entry under Settings > Apps all disappeared, with Windows reporting "This app can't be found".

**The program and your data were fine all along** - running `MaaAuto.exe` from the install folder worked normally. Only the *registration* was gone: the install/uninstall check that runs before a release used the same Inno AppId as your real installation, and Inno keeps the uninstall registry entry, the Start Menu group and the desktop shortcut shared per AppId, so that uninstall removed them for your install too.

**In this release**: the check scripts now install into a separate `MaaAuto_verify` folder, snapshot everything before and restore it afterwards, and refuse to run against the real install folder.

**Already affected?** No reinstall needed - run `tools/repair_integration.py` to recreate the icons and the Settings > Apps entry.

title.zh_CN: 1.4.1：修好 Windows 11 被识别成 Windows 10
title.en_US: 1.4.1: Windows 11 is no longer reported as Windows 10

body.zh_CN:
**一处显示错误**：「关于」页的系统版本以前在 Windows 11 上会显示成 `Windows 10 10.0.22631`。原因是 `platform.release()` 读的旧接口被兼容层钉死在 10.0，而注册表里的产品名在 Windows 11 上也还写着「Windows 10」。

现在改成按**构建号 + 注册表**识别，显示为 `Windows 11 专业版 23H2 (10.0.22631.4317)` 这样的完整信息；`diagnose.py` 也会打印同一行，反馈问题时直接贴即可。

这一版是**小更新**（`1.4.x`），找图、点击、定时和差分升级机制都没有变化。
body.en_US:
**One display bug**: the About page used to report Windows 11 as `Windows 10 10.0.22631`. `platform.release()` reads a legacy API that is pinned to 10.0 by the compatibility layer, and the registry product name still says "Windows 10" on Windows 11 as well.

It is now detected from the **build number + registry**, showing the full label such as `Windows 11 Pro 23H2 (10.0.22631.4317)`. `diagnose.py` prints the same line, so you can paste it into a bug report.

This is a **patch release** (`1.4.x`): matching, clicking, scheduling and delta updates are unchanged.

title.zh_CN: 1.4.0：跳版本差分 + 公告改成可搜索的更新日志
title.en_US: 1.4.0: multi-hop delta updates and a searchable announcement changelog

body.zh_CN:
**两个变化**：

- **跳版本也能走差分**：没有直达补丁时，会自动把已发布的差分包串成一条链（例如 1.2.0 → 1.3.0 → 1.4.0），逐级打补丁；全链路失败才回退整包，中间失败不会留下「半新半旧」的安装。
- **公告变成可搜索的更新日志**：所有历史版本都在同一个公告区，顶部搜索框可以按版本号（如 `1.3.0`）或关键词过滤，左侧目录点一下跳转。

**关于谁能用差分**：1.3.0 升级约 0.5 MB；1.2.0 走两步约 1 MB；**1.1.0 及更早仍然是整包（约 61 MB）**——差分能力是升级器自己带的，那些版本的 `upgrade.exe` 还不认识差分包，升级到 1.4.0 之后才会开始省流量。
body.en_US:
**Two changes:**

- **Multi-hop delta updates**: when there is no direct patch, published deltas are chained automatically (e.g. 1.2.0 -> 1.3.0 -> 1.4.0) and applied step by step. Only a full-chain failure falls back to the full payload, and a mid-chain failure leaves the installation untouched.
- **Announcements are now one searchable changelog**: every historical version lives in a single announcement area; the search box filters by version (e.g. `1.3.0`) or keyword, and the left index jumps to the matching section.

**Who gets deltas:** 1.3.0 upgrades with ~0.5 MB; 1.2.0 uses two hops (~1 MB); **1.1.0 and older still download the full ~61 MB payload** - delta support lives in the updater itself, and those builds' `upgrade.exe` does not understand delta assets yet. They start saving bandwidth from 1.4.0 onward.

title.zh_CN: 1.3.0：定时支持多时段与工作日，公告/滑条问题修好
title.en_US: 1.3.0: multiple run times and weekdays; announcement and slider fixes

body.zh_CN:
**定时更灵活了**：

- 一天可以设多个时间（如 08:00、20:30），分别触发；错过多个时只补跑最近一次；
- 可以勾选星期（一~日），一个都不勾 = 每天；首页「下次运行」会算到下一个符合条件的日子；
- 老配置的单个时间自动沿用，不用重设。

**顺手修了三个体验问题**：

- 公告「看一会就消失、重启又提示」：在线源可能返回旧缓存，以前会整份覆盖；现在按 id 合并，历史公告一直在，而且打开即标记已读；
- 公告改成一篇长文，左侧目录点一下跳转，滚轮可以连续看完所有版本更新；
- 背景透明度 / 模糊滑条拖动卡顿：原来每格都整图高斯模糊 + 写配置，现在缓存 + 缩小后模糊 + 防抖，拖动跟手。
body.en_US:
**More flexible scheduling:** multiple run times per day (e.g. 08:00 and 20:30), optional weekdays (none selected = every day), and Home shows the next matching run. Single-time configs keep working.

**Three fixes:** announcements no longer vanish and come back (the online source may be a stale cache; entries are now merged by id and marked read as soon as the dialog opens); all announcements render as one scrollable document with a clickable index; the background opacity/blur sliders no longer stutter (decode and blur are cached, blur runs on a downscaled copy, updates are debounced).

title.zh_CN: 1.2.0：升级只下变化的部分（61 MB → 0.6 MB）
title.en_US: 1.2.0: updates now download only what changed (61 MB -> 0.6 MB)

body.zh_CN:
**1.2.0 做的是「升级下载量」**：以前每次升级都要下 65 MB 的整包，国内网络下经常要等很久；现在只下变化的部分。

从 1.1.1 升上来实测 **0.64 MB**（省 98.9%）：Qt 的 DLL、内置模板这些没变的文件完全不下载，变了的 `MaaAuto.exe` / `upgrade.exe` 用二进制补丁（分别是 148 KB / 403 KB）。

几种情况会自动回退整包，不会报错：

- 跨多个版本升级，没有对应的差分包；
- 安装目录被手动改过（基准对不上）；
- 补丁包损坏（随后照旧回滚并提示）。

**注意**：差分能力是 1.2.0 的升级器带的，所以「1.1.1 → 1.2.0」这一跳本身还是整包，**从 1.2.0 往后的每次升级才会走差分**。

其它功能没有变化。
body.en_US:
**1.2.0 is about update download size.** Every update used to pull the full ~65 MB payload; now only the changed parts are downloaded.

Upgrading from 1.1.1 measured **0.64 MB** (98.9% smaller): unchanged files such as Qt DLLs and bundled templates are skipped entirely, while the changed `MaaAuto.exe` and `upgrade.exe` are delivered as binary patches (148 KB / 403 KB).

It falls back to the full payload silently when:

- you jump several versions (no matching delta);
- files in the install folder were modified (base mismatch);
- the delta is corrupt (the usual rollback and failure flag still apply).

**Note**: delta support ships with the 1.2.0 updater, so the 1.1.1 -> 1.2.0 hop itself is still a full download; updates *from* 1.2.0 onward use deltas.

No other behaviour changed.

title.zh_CN: 1.1.1：修好「点击生效」误判与假开关，任务日志可自动清理
title.en_US: 1.1.1: fixed false click-success detection and a dead switch; logs now auto-clean

body.zh_CN:
**1.1.1 是小修版**，修的是两件「日志说点了、其实没点到」的事：

- **「点击前激活窗口」开关以前不生效**：关掉它没有任何作用。现在关掉后只走后台点击（PostMessage），不发真实点击，避免点击落到当时的前台窗口上。
- **点击校验不再谎报成功**：截图失败（锁屏 / 远程桌面断开 / 窗口最小化）以前会被当成「画面变了」；另外「点击前」的画面是在激活窗口之前拍的，窗口一激活就被算成点中了。现在这两种情况都会明确写「无法校验」，不再假装成功。
- **任务日志不再无限增长**：设置 → 常规 →「任务日志保留天数」，默认 90 天，启动时自动清理更早的日志目录和找图失败截图。

已有 1.1.0 的用户：关于 → 检查更新即可，配置与日志都会保留。
body.en_US:
**1.1.1 is a patch release** fixing two cases where the log claimed a click succeeded when it did not:

- **The "activate window before clicking" switch did nothing**: turning it off had no effect. It now restricts clicking to background delivery (PostMessage) - no real clicks, so nothing lands on whatever window happens to be in front.
- **Click verification no longer over-reports success**: a failed screenshot (locked screen, RDP disconnected, minimized window) used to count as "the screen changed"; and the "before" frame was captured before activating the window, so activating it looked like a hit. Both cases are now reported as "cannot verify" instead of a fake success.
- **Task logs no longer grow forever**: Settings - General - "Keep task logs for (days)", default 90 days; older log folders and find-failure screenshots are cleaned up on startup.

Already on 1.1.0? Check for updates under About - your config and logs are kept.

title.zh_CN: 1.1.0 正式发布：找图点击重做、界面缩放、自动升级、新手教程
title.en_US: 1.1.0 is out: reworked vision & clicking, UI scaling, auto-update, tutorial

body.zh_CN:
**1.1.0 是首个正式版**，把找图点击、界面缩放、自动升级、新手引导都补齐了。

**第一次用请先改这两处**（不然自动化收不了尾）：

1. MAA → 设置 → 启动设置 → 勾选「完成后退出模拟器」；
2. MaaEnd → 任务列表 → **最后**添加「关闭程序」或「关闭模拟器」。

详细步骤见首页「新手教程」。

其它变化：

- 找图改成多尺度模板匹配，只在目标窗口内搜索；点击前激活窗口、点击后校验像素并自动补点；
- 界面缩放 100% / 125% / 150% **即时生效**，设置页和托盘都有「重启程序」；
- 升级窗口重做：版本对比 + 排版好的发布说明；重启/升级不再关掉 MAA / 模拟器；
- 背景模糊改成滑杆；深色模式可读性、卸载残留等问题修好。

**公告现在从 GitHub 在线拉取**：以后改公告只要编辑仓库里的 `announcements.json` 并 push，客户端下次启动就能看到，不需要发新版本。

title.zh_CN: 1.0.6：更新弹窗重做、新手教程、开始菜单可选
title.en_US: 1.0.6: new update dialog, beginner tutorial, optional Start Menu shortcut

body.zh_CN:
本版把「检查更新」的弹窗重新做了一遍：版本对比、Markdown 发布说明、明确的「立即升级 / 稍后 / 查看发布页」按钮。

同时新增：

- **新手教程**（首页右上角「新手教程」），第一次启动会自动弹出；
- **公告**（本窗口）；
- 安装时可选择是否创建开始菜单快捷方式。

修复：点「重启程序」会把已开的 MAA / MuMu 一起关掉；切换界面缩放偶尔出现的重影；深色模式下版本号看不清；卸载后开始菜单残留。
body.en_US:
This release rebuilds the update prompt: version comparison, Markdown release notes and explicit Update / Later / View release buttons.

Also new:

- **Beginner tutorial** (top-right of Home, shown automatically on first launch)
- **Announcements** (this window)
- Optional Start Menu shortcut during installation

Fixed: Restart closing your running MAA/MuMu; occasional ghosting after changing the interface scale; version tag unreadable in dark mode; Start Menu leftovers after uninstall.

title.zh_CN: 使用之前必须先改两处设置（MAA / MaaEnd）
title.en_US: Two settings you MUST change first (MAA / MaaEnd)

body.zh_CN:
**① MAA：一定要选择「完成后退出模拟器」**

`MAA → 设置 → 启动设置 → 完成后退出模拟器`

不勾选的话，任务跑完模拟器还开着，MaaAuto 会一直等不到「模拟器退出」，后续阶段/下次启动都可能失败。

**② MaaEnd：一定要在任务列表最后添加「关闭程序」或「关闭模拟器」**

`MaaEnd → 任务列表 → 末尾添加「关闭程序」/「关闭模拟器」`

最后这一条是给 MaaAuto 的「任务结束」信号：没有它，MaaAuto 无法判断 MaaEnd 已经跑完，会一直等到超时（默认 2 小时）。

详细步骤见「新手教程」。
body.en_US:
**① MAA: enable “Quit emulator when finished”**

`MAA → Settings → Startup → Quit emulator when finished`

Without it the emulator stays open after the task, MaaAuto never sees the emulator exit, and later stages / the next run can fail.

**② MaaEnd: add “Close program” or “Close emulator” as the LAST task**

`MaaEnd → Task list → append “Close program” / “Close emulator”`

That last task is MaaAuto's “task finished” signal. Without it MaaAuto cannot tell MaaEnd has finished and waits until timeout (2 hours by default).

See the beginner tutorial for the full walkthrough.

title.zh_CN: 自动更新与任务结果推送

body.zh_CN:
**自动更新**：`设置 → 常规 → 自动下载并升级`。勾选后检测到新版本会等任务结束再升级，并自动重启。更新频道可选「稳定版」或「测试版」（测试版会收到 b1/rc 预发布）。

**任务结果推送**：`设置 → 定时与推送`，支持 Server 酱 SendKey 与通用 Webhook（POST JSON `{title, content}`），任务成功/失败/中止都会推送。

**定时执行**：同一分区可设每日执行时间；到点时若任务仍在跑，会在结束后自动补跑一次。
body.en_US:
**Automatic updates**: `Settings → General → Automatically download and install updates`. When enabled, a new version is installed after the current task finishes, and MaaAuto restarts itself. Channel can be Stable or Beta (Beta receives b1/rc prereleases).

**Task notifications**: `Settings → Schedule & Notifications` supports ServerChan SendKey and a generic Webhook (POST JSON `{title, content}`) for success/failure/abort.

**Scheduling**: set a daily run time; if a task is still running at that time, it runs once afterwards.

title.zh_CN: 出问题怎么反馈（日志在哪）
title.en_US: How to report a problem (where the logs are)

body.zh_CN:
**一键导出**：`关于 → 导出日志`，会把 `logs/` 打包成 zip。

**任务日志**：`%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\MaaAuto\logs\年\月\日\run_N_时间\task.log`

**MAA 自己的日志**：`<MAA 安装目录>\debug\asst.log` —— 卡在 MAA 阶段时这个最有用（连接失败、任务报错都在里面）。

反馈时请附上：版本号、当时的界面缩放、`task.log`，以及（若卡在 MAA 阶段）`asst.log`。
body.en_US:
**One click**: `About → Export logs` packs `logs/` into a zip.

**Task log**: `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\MaaAuto\logs\<year>\<month>\<day>\run_N_<time>\task.log`

**MAA's own log**: `<MAA install dir>\debug\asst.log` — most useful when a run gets stuck in the MAA stage (connection failures and task errors are there).

When reporting, include: version, interface scale, `task.log`, and `asst.log` if the MAA stage failed.
